notes.title: Shinjuku Hearts One Year Anniversary
notes.notes:
It’s already been one year since the release of Shinjuku Hearts! 

We extend our thanks and appreciation to the generous people who purchased the game. The support has been immensely humbling. To commemorate the occasion, the game will be half price for a limited time for those yet to experience it. Also makes a nice, affordable gift for friends who may enjoy the sexy arts!

In addition, we would like to use this opportunity to announce that we have been hard at work on [i][b]Shinjuku Hearts 2[/b][/i]! Please look forward to it and keep an eye out for updates!

Thanks as always and until next time!

Koi Spirit Team

notes.title: LATAM Pricing Fix
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

It has been brought to our attention that the pricing for LATAM countries was not appropriately set. We have now set it accordingly and deeply apologise to our Latin American friends for the oversight. Many thanks to JR from Argentina for informing us through email. As always, we greatly appreciate the community and the feedback.

Koi Spirit Team

notes.title: Gallery Mode Now Live!
notes.notes:
We heard you and the much requested gallery mode feature is now live!

Gallery mode contains:

- All in-game erotic scenes
- Behind the scenes and concept art
- Backgrounds
- Extra artwork never before released

For those with existing saves, you may need to re-visit your favourite scenes in order for them to be added to the gallery.

Can you discover them all?

As always, we are deeply grateful for all the support and we highly appreciate this community. Keep your eyes open for more updates in the future!


Koi Spirit Team

notes.title: Coming soon: Free Update - Gallery Mode
notes.notes:
Hello All, we hope you are doing well! 

Due to popular player feedback, we are happy to announce that a gallery mode will be implemented soon into the game at no additional cost.

We apologise for the delay and as always, we appreciate all those who have purchased the game and all our supporters. We plan on releasing more free content so please keep an eye out for that. Until next time!


Koi Spirit Team

notes.title: Giveaway for Shinjuku Hearts Reviewers!
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone! 

We would just like to tell all those who purchased Shinjuku Hearts, that we are unbelievably grateful for all the support so far. There are countless awesome games out there and to take a chance on our fledgling visual novel, it is beyond humbling.

So in response for all those who go above and beyond in leaving a Steam Store review, we'd like to give a small personalised digital art gift.

If you are interested, please send an email to [b]koispirit99@gmail.com [/b] and be sure to include your profile name in the message. Once we have confirmed your review on the Shinjuku Hearts store page, we will respond back with your gift.

Thank you again for your time and if you like what we do, please consider telling your friends and others that may be interested. It would help us immensely.

For other news and future updates, follow us on Patreon at [b]https://www.patreon.com/koispirit[/b] or for one-time donations and commissions page at [b]https://www.buymeacoffee.com/koispirit[/b]

Until next time!


[b]Koi Spirit Team[/b]
